Dog, cat and other pet owners · in French

Pet care tracker

For your dog, cat or any other pet. Each recurring care item (vaccine booster, flea and tick treatment, dewormer, grooming, claws) with its last date and the interval your vet gave you: next due date, overdue items and what is coming up; a date set by the vet always comes first. No vaccination schedule is built in and no dosage is ever suggested. Weight curve weighing after weighing, vet visits with the prescribed treatment copied from the prescription, every expense by category, month and year, and a printable record for a boarding kennel or a new vet. Not a substitute for veterinary advice.
